description: Scheduled and running downtimes for services. Leave hostname/servicename empty for all services. Set only_active=True for downtimes running right now.

hostname.description: Restrict to this host. Empty means every host.

limit.description: Maximum rows to return. Defaults to 50, maximum 500.

only_active.description: True returns only downtimes running right now, not those scheduled for later.

servicename.description: Restrict to this service. Empty means every service.

name: list_service_downtimes

outputSchema.description: Rows plus enough context to know whether they are all of them.

hint.description: How to narrow the query when truncated.

items.description: The rows, at most `limit` of them.

truncated.description: True if openITCOCKPIT held more rows than were returned.

title: Service Downtimes
